svg.title: Full-cycle spectral signal snippets composited at a shorter control interval
svg.desc: Three complete one-cycle IFFT waveforms are aligned by oscillator phase. New full-cycle frames arrive at output-sample control frontiers separated by H, shorter than a C1 cycle. The output follows frame zero, then crossfades frame zero to one and frame one to two over successive H-length intervals. A cursor at 2.5H samples frames one and two at the same phase and blends them equally.
svg.text: One oscillator cycle contains several spectral control updates
Signal snippets at steady C1 pitch, 44.1 kHz: H = 256 output samples; cycle period ≈ 1,349 samples (≈ 5.27H).
Each Fₘ is a whole-cycle N-sample IFFT buffer. H sets when another buffer is rendered and how long its transition lasts.
later frames continue within this cycle
No H-sample FFT grains are placed here.
The same running phase samples each
The x-alignment shows one steady-pitch cycle; with pitch movement, the running lane phase determines each lookup position.
